title: Irish Stew
description: A low-carb, keto-friendly twist on the classic Irish stew. This hearty dish is loaded with flavorful stew meat and vegetables.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, brown the stew meat over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced potatoes, keto-friendly broth, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
